$comment: DORA derivation policy. Every key here changes the numbers, so this file is declared as the dora sensor's coverage-inputs and its content is hashed into the evidence policy fingerprint: editing a threshold makes prior dora evidence stale instead of silently incomparable. Bands: max_lead_p90_days is 30 (not 14) because this repo's first release deployed 27.03 days after its first commit; a 14-day bar would breach permanently on first-release history and stop carrying information.
